|lore=Senior '''Jedi Council member'''. Responsible for the early training of Obi-Wan Kenobi. When Qui-Gon brought Anakin before the Council, Yoda voted not to train the boy.
|game_text=Deploys only to [Episode I] sites. While at Jedi Council Chamber, immune to attrition, Jedi are deploy -2 here, and (unless a Dark Jedi here) other Jedi may treat “Jedi Council Chamber” in their game text as “[Episode I] battleground sites.”
